blurb: They specialize in therapeutic and deep tissue massage therapy to decrease muscular tension, increase flexibility, and strengthen the body. Services include shockwave therapy for pain and injury rehabilitation, myofascial cupping to decompress connective tissue, manual lymphatic drainage for lymphedema and related conditions, and reflexology to stimulate healing through pressure points on feet and hands. Cupping is included at no extra cost.
extraNote: Rates do not include GST · Inside the Nardella Clinic, Suite 202, 1910, 20th Ave NW, Calgary Alberta T2M 1H5
